reproducedIssues.rootCause: Product Intelligence rendered only text cards without any product image/video gallery, thumbnail strip, lightbox, or HTML5 video player.
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Created src/services/kh02/media/productMediaResolver.ts and added a responsive Product Media Gallery (pi-media-gallery) with main viewer, thumbnail strip, Lightbox modal, HTML5 video player, and honest source badges.

reproducedIssues.observedIn: User Screenshot 1 & 2 (Automatic Dog Feeder on Product Finder)
reproducedIssues.rootCause: productFinderViewModel.ts checked candidate.canonicalProductUrl.includes('/products/') to add 'Merchant product page verified' even when identityStatus was PROBABLE and fetchOutcome was HTTP_404.
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Restricted merchantPageVerified in productFinderViewModel.ts to require identityStatus === 'VERIFIED' and fetchOutcome not in HTTP_ERROR/HTTP_404/NON_PRODUCT_PAGE/HOMEPAGE.

reproducedIssues.observedIn: User Screenshot 1 (Source Coverage vs Recommended Card)
reproducedIssues.rootCause: Source Coverage displayed '0 cached records' when sourceCoverage was missing on top-level response, while product cards showed historical supporting ad counts without distinguishing current-run live vs cached ads.
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Persisted and reconciled sourceCoverage (currentRunLiveAdsCount vs currentRunCachedAdsCount) and separated per-product supportingAdCount and observationCount.

reproducedIssues.rootCause: Card 'Why it fits your search' fell back to verificationReason ('Merchant product page verified (OpenGraph title, DOM title, price USD 89.99)').
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Implemented buildBuyerOrientedWhyItFits() for buyer/seller-focused card copy and moved technical OpenGraph/JSON-LD verification strings to the Research Drawer.

reproducedIssues.rootCause: intelligence/page.tsx fell back from opportunityAssessment.evidenceReadinessScore to kh02ResearchContext.evidenceConfidence, displaying '75/100' next to '0/100 Weak'.
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Strictly separated Research Score (KH-02) from Commercial Opportunity (KH-01) and Evidence Readiness (KH-01), displaying 'Not Assessed' when opportunityAssessment is null.

reproducedIssues.rootCause: runAcceptanceAsyncV12_4_3_2 mapped r.value instead of r.demandValue, and shortfall notice lacked a direct [View Missing Evidence] action.
reproducedIssues.repairSummary: Mapped demandValue: r.demandValue, value: r.demandValue in forensic audit and built compact non-compressing shortfall notice with [View Missing Evidence].
